summary: Timestamped comparison of the cbXRP/USDC Morpho market on Base and FXRP/RLUSD Morpho market on Ethereum, with Flare FAssets dashboard flow conflicts retained as separate observations. No spot-demand or directional-price conclusion is inferred.

market_observations.official_product_linkage: Coinbase officially documents XRP-backed USDC loans through Morpho and cbXRP collateral. MorphoWatch labels this exact market as the market behind Coinbase's XRP loans; Coinbase does not publish this market ID in the cited help page, so exact market attribution remains a high-confidence third-party match, not an issuer-labelled contract mapping.
limitations: Provider reports a Morpho API update time; this is not a raw independently replayed block snapshot.
Borrower count is addresses/open loans, not verified unique natural persons or Coinbase customers.
Available liquidity is market-level and should not be confused with total vault withdrawals.
The market is permissionless; not every position can be attributed to Coinbase consumer loans.
Borrower concentration is derived from the three largest positions displayed by the provider.
Vault total deposits are not market-level withdrawable liquidity.
Market data is not synchronized with the cbXRP/USDC snapshot.
Borrower addresses are not attributed to legal persons.

cross_market_derived_metrics.basis: 118.75M cbXRP collateral divided by Coinbase proof-of-reserves page's 150.9400898M cbXRP supply.
cross_market_derived_metrics.timestamp_warning: Coinbase's page displayed a November 2 refresh at 2:03 AM with timezone unspecified; MorphoWatch reports 16:31 UTC. This ratio is approximate and non-synchronous.
cross_market_derived_metrics.basis_2: 59.26M USDC divided by 8.45M RLUSD from two different provider update times; ratio is descriptive only, not a simultaneous market share.
cross_market_derived_metrics.basis_3: 13.49M FXRP collateral divided by 143.98M FXRP dashboard supply; page retrievals are close in time but not block-synchronized.
cross_market_derived_metrics.utilization_comparison: Both markets are near Morpho's 90% target utilization; cbXRP/USDC was 89.2%, FXRP/RLUSD 90.3%.

flare_dashboard_data_quality.issue: Two captures returned during the same research run report different trailing-24-hour net flow and success-rate values.
flare_dashboard_data_quality.differences: Capture 1 reports -18.2K FXRP net redemptions and 80.6% success; capture 2 reports +7.9K FXRP net minting and 83.8% success.
flare_dashboard_data_quality.treatment: Preserve as separate observations. Do not average, choose one as canonical, or treat the difference as an economic reversal until provider refresh timestamps and raw request/transaction denominators are available.
flare_dashboard_data_quality.definition_notes: Flare Metrics defines net flow as FXRP minted minus redeemed. It defines success rate as the share of FAssets requests completed without payment default.
flare_dashboard_data_quality.denominator_warning: The six payment defaults and success-rate denominator require transaction-level reconciliation.
flare_dashboard_data_quality.reserve_vs_pool_collateral: The 100.01% proof-of-reserve metric is distinct from the 621–630% collateral ratio and 824.85–825.36M FLR agent-pool collateral. Do not treat the latter as additional XRP reserves.

coinbase_cbXRP.limitation: Displayed refresh timezone and block/ledger cutoff are not exposed in the retrieved page text.

flare_fxrp.limitation: This earlier FlareForge API snapshot is not synchronized with the later MorphoWatch or Flare Metrics observations.

relationship_edges.relation: consumer crypto-backed USDC loan product routes through Morpho
issues XRP representation backed by XRP reserves and agent collateral

causal_hypotheses.claim: Collateralized stablecoin borrowing may reduce immediate spot selling by allowing holders to obtain liquidity without selling XRP exposure.
causal_hypotheses.supporting: Both markets have measurable outstanding stablecoin debt backed by XRP representations.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming: No borrower-use-of-proceeds data; borrowing does not prove the borrower otherwise would have sold XRP.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Collateral markets create incremental utility and can increase demand to hold or wrap XRP.
causal_hypotheses.supporting: 118.75M cbXRP and 13.49M FXRP are posted as collateral in the captured markets.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming: Collateral posting may reflect migration of existing holders; it does not establish net new XRP acquisition.

causal_hypotheses.claim: High utilization and borrower concentration can amplify liquidation and liquidity feedback under adverse price moves.
causal_hypotheses.supporting: Both markets are near 90% utilization; FXRP/RLUSD top three borrowers represent about 90.8% of debt.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming: Current bad debt is reported as zero; displayed health factors remain above 1; the FXRP market has only small reported liquidation repayments.

causal_hypotheses.claim: FXRP introduces bridge, Core Vault governance and redemption-timing risks beyond native XRP price risk.
causal_hypotheses.supporting: FXRP relies on agents, a multisig Core Vault, KYC-gated direct redemptions and scheduled processing.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming: Flare reports 100.01% proof of reserve and zero pending mints in the captured dashboard.

causal_hypotheses.claim: cbXRP market activity is more distributed across borrowers than FXRP/RLUSD in the captured snapshots.
causal_hypotheses.supporting: MorphoWatch reports 12,056 open loans for cbXRP/USDC versus 57 for FXRP/RLUSD; displayed top cbXRP loans are around $200K each while FXRP top three exceed $7.6M.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming: Address counts are not verified unique beneficial owners; exact Coinbase attribution is a third-party market match.

causal_hypotheses.claim: The similar ~90% utilization levels may reflect market rate-model targets rather than independent evidence of system-wide XRP credit demand.
causal_hypotheses.supporting: MorphoWatch documents a 90% target utilization curve for both markets.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming: Both markets also show actual outstanding borrowing and collateral, but causality of the shared utilization level is not established.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Near-100% reserve coverage does not by itself guarantee immediate redemption liquidity.
causal_hypotheses.supporting: Flare documentation specifies KYC and daily direct-user redemption processing, manual multisig governance and priority rules.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming: No pending mints were shown and the proof-of-reserve indicator was 100.01%.

source_independence.morphowatch: One secondary source group using Morpho API for both markets. The two pages are not independent corroboration.
source_independence.coinbase: Issuer primary source for cbXRP reserve figures and Coinbase product eligibility; exact Morpho market mapping remains third-party inference.
source_independence.flaremetrics: Secondary Flare FAssets dashboard; raw block-level payload hashes were not captured.
source_independence.flareforge: Separate public API/dashboard with explicit Flare block and XRPL ledger; underlying data lineage may overlap Flare protocol feeds and is not assumed fully independent.
source_independence.conclusion: No source-counting inflation. Provider diversity is recorded, but independent underlying data provenance remains partially unresolved.

data_quality_flags: MorphoWatch market timestamps differ: cbXRP 16:31 UTC, FXRP 18:11 UTC.
Coinbase proof-of-reserves displayed refresh timezone is unspecified.
Flare Metrics returned conflicting trailing-24-hour flow and success values during the same research run.
MorphoWatch is a single provider group for both markets.
Borrower addresses do not identify beneficial owners.
No raw transaction-by-transaction Morpho replay or API response hashes were captured in this run.
No borrower destination-of-proceeds analysis was performed.
cbXRP and FXRP are representations of native XRP and must not be double-counted as additional native XRP supply.

prediction_engine_policy.reason: The observations are cross-time, provider-dependent, and incomplete for causal attribution. No fixed-horizon out-of-sample evaluation attestation is available.
next_required_work: Capture immutable raw Morpho market state at pinned Base and Ethereum blocks.
Capture synchronized Coinbase XRP reserve and cbXRP supply snapshot with explicit timezone/block metadata.
Reconcile FXRP Core Vault reserve against pinned XRPL ledger and Flare block.
Replay liquidation events and liquidator receipts; distinguish collateral seizure from subsequent native XRP sale.
Track borrower concentration and health-factor changes over time.
Resolve Flare Metrics trailing-24h flow and success-rate denominator discrepancies.
Build fixed-horizon point-in-time features and independent evaluation attestation before any forecast.

limitations: This is a research snapshot, not investment advice or a forecast.
No real-money or paper-trading positions were changed.
No private borrower identity was inferred.
Market observations are not synchronized; derived ratios are explicitly approximate.
